st_reflets.name: Place des Témoins
st_reflets.alt: A sunny grassy clearing on the sandy path along the shore of the park lake, with round bushes and rocks at the water's edge; along the back an ivy-covered wall with a blue arched door and a green arched door, a white picket gate and a little wooden boathouse with a red door by the water. Monsieur Verbe raises his right hand at the witness stand holding up an onion; spins a toy windmill on a table; crouches with a cat watching a mouse hole; poses inside an empty gilded frame; jumps for joy with a smiley placard; and tunes an old radio on a crate. The sandy path on the left leads back to the Parc des Curiosités.

doors.label: Rue des Miroirs
doors.hint: Through the green arched door in the ivy wall

doors.label: Passage des Espions
doors.hint: Through the red door of the boathouse

soupcons.name: Ruelle des Soupçons
soupcons.alt: The flowery back garden of a lakeside cottage, with washing on a line and the lake glinting behind: Monsieur Verbe swings a net at a blue butterfly; leaps back in a green beret as an orange cat bursts out of the laundry basket; studies a black cat by a bowl of soup through a magnifying glass; pretends to faint on the bench in a gold beret; and rings a brass bell as a white duck flaps away. The blue door on the left leads back to the square; the red boathouse door leads on.

doors.label: Passage des Espions
doors.hint: Through the red door of the boathouse

berceaux.name: Allée des Berceaux
berceaux.alt: A little apple orchard on the lake shore with a hammock between two apple trees and a blank signboard on a post: Monsieur Verbe rocks a cradle with a sleeping teddy bear; pesters a grumpy white goat; opens an old chest to find a golden crown, hand mirror in hand; points at the blank plaque like a guide; wakes up yawning in the hammock as the rooster crows; and cranks a jack-in-the-box. The white picket gate on the left leads back to the square; the green gate in the hedge leads to the Rue des Miroirs.

doors.label: Place des Témoins
doors.hint: Back through the white picket gate

doors.label: Rue des Miroirs
doors.hint: Through the green gate in the hedge

espions.name: Passage des Espions
espions.alt: The reedy landing in front of the wooden boathouse under the willows, with a rowing boat tied up on the lake, a low hedge and a tree stump: Monsieur Verbe spies over the hedge through binoculars; cups his ear in a gold beret beside a purse on the stump; holds his buzzing phone; scowls at a fly by his ear; and stands surrounded by geese. The red boathouse door leads back to the square.

doors.label: Place des Témoins
doors.hint: Back through the red boathouse door

miroirs.name: Rue des Miroirs
miroirs.alt: An old walled garden opening onto the still, mirror-like shore of the lake, with a pink blossom tree, a willow and a cream vintage car with its headlights on: Monsieur Verbe wears a flower garland beside a red parrot on its perch; covers his eyes, dazzled by the headlights; listens to the rustling tree in a gold beret; pulls a face at a bowl of spinach; and kneels to see his reflection in the lake. The green gate in the wall leads back to the square.

doors.label: Place des Témoins
doors.hint: Back through the green garden gate
